notes: Geometry is px in the 1080×1920 frame, origin top-left; center is [x, y].
An element is invisible until its appear cue, unless it has visibleAtStart (drawn from the beat's first frame).
Draw order is declaration order across the episode: an element declared later draws on top (Mismatch excepted, see its spec).
Scaling (moveTo with w/h, resize, standAndFit, focusKept) changes geometry only: stroke widths and text sizes never scale.

Cues sharing an anchor run in parallel, except that an appear or reveal waits for the exits on its anchor to finish (the player's rule, so new content never draws over old). A cue with neither speed nor until uses base.
Easing from studio/src/style/theme.ts: ease.out for appear and reveal, ease.in for exit, ease.smooth for everything else, unless a cue's params say ease: linear.
h/w is long ÷ short for every portrait sheet; √2 = 1.4142.

colors.text: the sheet itself (and the white flash when a half lands back on it in B1), plain math
colors.muted: the original outline (dashed ghost), fold lines, dimmed digits, number-line axis
colors.yellow: long side: its edges, its label (x, √2, 297 mm), the value 1.414 (live h/w in B7, the shared digits in B8)
colors.blue: short side: its edges, its label (1, x/2, 210 mm)
colors.teal: the folded half and the flash when the √2 sheet fits
colors.red: does not fit: mismatch shading, the Letter mark on the number line, Letter's 1.55 after folding

components.name: Tex
components.spec: KaTeX renderer (studio/src/components/Tex.tsx); props tex, display, fontSize, color. Every math label below renders through it. Equation needs KaTeX's trust option for \htmlId, so Tex gains a `trust` prop (or Equation calls katex directly).

components.name: PaperRect
components.spec: A sheet of paper: an axis-aligned rectangle. Props: center [x,y], w, h (px); stroke (color, default text); strokeWidth (default 6); fill (color, default = stroke) at fillOpacity (default 0.08); dashed (bool: 18 px dash, 12 px gap); edgeColors {long?, short?} overrides stroke per edge pair (long = the longer pair, recomputed live); labels {bottom?, right?}: {tex, color}, drawn with Tex at type.mathInline, upright, 24 px outside that edge's midpoint, re-anchored whenever the geometry changes; name: plain text centered inside (type.label, color text); valueLabel {side: right, color}: the right label shows the live h/w with 3 decimals; followHalfOf: element id; this element then has no own geometry and every frame takes the standAndFit end result of that element's half (see standAndFit). Labels never rotate or fold: in this storyboard no element carries labels or a name through a fold or rotate. Actions: appear {mode?: draw|fade} (draw, the default: stroke draws on clockwise from the top-left corner, then fill, labels and name fade in; fade: everything fades in together); exit (fade out with labels); moveTo {center, w?, h?}; resize {ratio} (keeps w and the bottom edge, h = w × ratio); showMidline (dashed muted line across the middle, parallel to the short sides, drawn from its center outward); fold (always across the long side, never the other way. First 30%: the dashed muted midline draws in and the name fades out. Remaining 70%: the top half (the flap) flips down onto the bottom half about the midline, drawn as a y-scale 1 → −1 of the flap; the flap keeps the sheet's stroke with its fill raised to 0.2 while it flips; over the same 70% the whole sheet's stroke and fill crossfade to teal. Afterwards the element IS the bottom half: stroke teal, fill teal at 0.08; the midline is gone, it has become the half's top edge); rotate {deg} (clockwise about its center; the center must not be moving at the same time); standAndFit {ref} (the match-widths rule for 'same shape' overlays: first 40% rotate 90° clockwise about its center, remaining 60% scale uniformly and move so its width equals ref's width and the bottom-left corners coincide; a similar rectangle then lands exactly on ref, any other one sticks out at the top or falls short of it); setStyle {any style prop} (colors crossfade; a label's tex change morphs old into new); pulse {edges?: long|short|all, color?} (stroke width to 2× and back, optionally flashing to color; pulses on different edges combine).

components.name: Mismatch
components.spec: Shades where two rectangles disagree: the region inside exactly one of elements a and b (symmetric difference), filled with color (default red) at opacity 0.35, no stroke, recomputed every frame from their live geometry. Always drawn beneath a and b, whatever the declaration order. Actions: appear (fade in), exit.

components.name: Equation
components.spec: One line of KaTeX built from addressable parts. Props: parts [{id, tex, color}]; fontSize (default type.mathDisplay); y = the baseline, so '=' and digits stay put when parts change; either centerX (whole row centered there) or align {part, x} (that part's horizontal center at x, used to line up rows on '='). Rendered in display style (\displaystyle) without KaTeX's display-mode margins, as ONE KaTeX expression with each part wrapped (\htmlId) so spacing is KaTeX's own. Parts are invisible until revealed, but the layout reserves their space. Actions: reveal {parts} (fade in while rising the last 20 px into place; no parts = all); transformTo {parts, morph?} (new part list and layout on the same baseline; parts with the same id slide to their new place and take their new color; morph {newId: [oldIds]} moves those old parts onto the new part while crossfading into it; other old parts fade out, other new parts fade in); recolor {colors: {partId: color}}; box {part, color} (rounded rectangle around the part, 12 px padding, 4 px stroke, drawn on); exit.

components.name: NumberLine
components.spec: Horizontal number line. Props: min, max, x0, x1 (px of min and max), y; ends (bool: min/max numbers below the ends, muted, type.label); marks [{value, tex, color}] (a 24 px tick in color plus the tex label below the line, Tex at fontSize 44); markerFrom: element id whose live h/w places a yellow down-pointing triangle (28 px wide) just above the line. Line muted, 4 px. Actions: appear (line draws left to right, then ticks, labels and marker fade in); pulseMark {value} (that mark's tick and label scale 1.3× and back); exit.

components.name: Dimension
components.spec: Measurement line along one edge of an element: parallel to the edge, same length, 16 px end ticks, 4 px stroke, offset outward. Props: of (element id), side (bottom|right), offset (px), label {tex, color}; the line takes the label color. The label sits beyond the line (below it for bottom, right of it for right), upright, type.mathInline. Tracks the element's live geometry. Actions: appear (line grows from its middle outward, then the label fades in), exit.

components.name: HalvingNest
components.spec: A sheet cut in half again and again (the A-series picture). Props: center, w, h (the starting sheet, portrait); title: name (plain text, styled like PaperRect.name), a muted middle dot, then sub (Tex at type.mathInline, muted), on one line centered over the sheet with its bottom 24 px above the sheet's top edge, outside the sheet so no cut line ever crosses it; labels [plain text per level, type.label]; stroke (default text). Outline and cut lines use stroke at width 6; every piece is filled with stroke at 0.08, exactly like a default PaperRect. Every cut goes across the current piece's long side (parallel to its short sides). Level 1 horizontal, keep bottom; level 2 vertical, keep right; level 3 horizontal, keep bottom; level 4 vertical, keep right. At levels 1 to 3 the half set aside keeps its outline and gets that level's label, muted, centered in it. At the last level the set-aside half stays unlabeled and the kept piece gets the label, in text. Actions: appear (outline draws on, then the title fades in; the title stays through every split and fades out with the rest in focusKept); split {levels} (levels run back to back, evenly spread over the cue's span; each cut line draws in, then its label fades in); pulseKept {color} (kept piece's stroke flashes to color and back); focusKept {center, w, h, name} (everything but the kept piece fades out while the kept piece moves and scales to that geometry; stroke width and label size never scale. The end state must be pixel-identical to a default-style PaperRect with that geometry and name; production may swap one in on the last frame); exit.
